question: Should OpenClaw bundle and permanently own this Twilio-backed RCS channel, or should it ship as an external ClawHub code plugin with only proven missing generic plugin APIs proposed separately?
rationale: The existing channel-plugin and ClawHub paths can host this optional commercial-service integration, while the contributor argues that carrier-driven RCS behavior belongs beside bundled SMS; automation cannot choose that long-term ownership and support boundary.

options.title: External ClawHub plugin
options.body: Publish RCS as a code plugin and submit only a narrowly justified generic webhook API enhancement to core if the external implementation proves it is necessary.

options.title: Sponsor bundled channel
options.body: Accept permanent core ownership of the Twilio RCS configuration, credentials, webhook, delivery, documentation, and upgrade surface after all patch, dependency, conflict, and live-proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Pause for scope decision
options.body: Keep the branch unmerged until the paired feature issue records an explicit ownership decision.

recommendation.title: External ClawHub plugin
recommendation.body: Publish RCS as a code plugin and submit only a narrowly justified generic webhook API enhancement to core if the external implementation proves it is necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged bundled Twilio SMS implementation is the closest product precedent, and this person introduced that adjacent behavior.
